[Council File 26-1057]
Motion (Raman - Blumenfield) relative to amending the Los Angeles Municipal Code to designate pathways for bicycles and electric bicycles in Department of Recreation and Parks facilities.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Ordinance to designate pathways for bicycles and electric bicycles in Department of Recreation and Parks facilities.

flag.reason: Would set where bikes and e-bikes may ride in Rec & Parks facilities, which includes Griffith Park and other watched parks.

outcome.text: Arts, Parks, and City Facilities Committee approved item(s) (Oct 7, 2026)
